# archestra_virtual_api_key (Resource)

Revocable virtual LLM key with explicit provider routing, billing and spend cap. The sensitive value is saved only on creation; import adopts metadata without retrieving a bearer credential. Change rotation_nonce to replace and revoke the key. Passthrough keys carry no provider credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_virtual_api_key" "example" {
  name = "model-router"
  provider_api_keys = [{
    provider            = "openai"
    provider_api_key_id = archestra_llm_provider_api_key.example.id
  }]
  spend_cap = { limit_value = 100, cleanup_interval = "calendar_month" }
  # Changing this value replaces the key and revokes its previous credential.
  rotation_nonce = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key display name.

### Optional

- `billing_team_id` (String) Team billed for this key; removing the value clears team billing.
- `expires_at` (String) Absolute RFC 3339 expiry; omission removes expiry.
- `include_future_providers` (Boolean) Use current and future shared primary provider keys, with explicit mappings as overrides.
- `initial_grants` (Attributes Set) Direct grants applied atomically when the object is created; changes require replacement, and later permission changes belong to archestra_resource_permission_policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_grants))
- `key_type` (String) Immutable standard or passthrough key type.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Credential labels; an empty set clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `owner_id` (String) Creation-only owner selector, defaulting to the creator.
- `provider_api_keys` (Attributes Set) Explicit provider-to-key mappings; an empty set clears explicit mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_api_keys))
- `rotation_nonce` (String) Change this value to replace the key and revoke its old credential.
- `spend_cap` (Attributes) Credential-wide spend cap; removing it clears the cap. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spend_cap))

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String) Owning identity.
- `author_name` (String) Author display name.
- `billing_team_name` (String) Billing team display name.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Creating service account UUID.
- `id` (String) Virtual key UUID.
- `last_used_at` (String) Most recent use timestamp.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier.
- `scope` (String) Legacy visibility projection; permissions are managed separately.
- `secret_id` (String) Stored credential identifier.
- `teams` (String) Legacy team visibility metadata as JSON.
- `token_start` (String) Non-secret identifying prefix.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Bearer credential returned on creation and retained in sensitive state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_virtual_api_key.example <id>
```
